{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'techmocaquiztililia' (making us understand) in the third point", "'titocencahuacan' (prepare ourselves) in 'yc titocencahuacan yc titochichihuacan'; only 'adorn' is kept"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["xicmotlacuilican 'borrow from' -> 'demand by force'", "neyollotiloz 'it must be noted/heeded' -> 'one must take heart'", "camix tecomatl / mixtecomatl 'thick darkness' -> note 'the vessel of cloud'", "techmoyoliuhtlamachtilia 'exhorts us' -> 'gives us courage' (minor)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["teotlahuiztli 'armour/weapons (of light)' -> 'the divine light' (loses the sense of armour)", "çan huel neneuhqui 'exactly alike' -> 'very much alike' (minor)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly renders 'borrow' and 'thick darkness' and keeps both 'prepare and adorn'; A misreads these and also drops small phrases."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'milacatzoz' (turn away / swerve) in the Advent passage is not rendered as such; it is folded into 'become guilty and blameworthy'"], "added": ["in the days to come"], "mistranslated": ["occecni momelahuaz, occecni tecaquitiloz (it will be explained elsewhere, taught elsewhere) -> 'another will be set forth, another will be heard'", "ticnopillahuelilocattin (be wicked/ungrateful) -> 'be blameworthy through our own fault'", "çan in ic yc nopillahueliloque (they were wicked/ungrateful toward it) -> 'they became guilty by it'", "in ic ahmo çan no yehuatl ... milacatzoz (so that we too do not turn away through disobedience and wickedness) -> 'so that we do not become guilty and blameworthy by the same ingratitude'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["<meta>continues from previous page: \"And now\"</meta> (an editorial claim not visible on this page)"], "mistranslated": ["otlacauhtzino iyollotzin (his heart was generous / he condescended) -> 'He gave up His heart'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is complete and accurate apart from small slips, while A misreads 'occecni' (elsewhere) in the opening, adds 'in the days to come', and blurs the sense of the wickedness and turning-away passages."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ahmo quimiximatcanenectzino, ahmo quimothuicanenectzino (He did not wish to recognize/acknowledge them; the desiderative 'did not want to' is lost) -> 'He did not recognize them, He did not acknowledge them'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["itlaçotlacatilitzin: 'precious' in 'his precious birth' is dropped", "quimopaccatlahpalhuizque: 'how they will greet him joyfully' is not rendered as such"], "added": ["\"the rich and the nobles, and even more so the poor commoners\""], "mistranslated": ["tictopaccacelilizque (we will joyfully receive Him) -> 'may joyfully welcome the day'", "in ahuaque tepehuaque, occenca yc pahpaqui yc mocuiltonohua (the inhabitants; they rejoice even more and feel enriched) -> 'the rich and the nobles, and even more so the poor commoners, who are made happy and prosperous'", "in catlehuatl in tetlahpalohuaya yez (what their greeting gift will be) -> 'gladden him with whatever will be to his taste'", "in ye imman in ye oncan quimocelilizquia (when it was time for them to receive Him) -> 'when He was about to receive them'", "ahmo quimothuicanenectzino (He did not wish to acknowledge them) -> 'did not take them with Him'", "in aacque, in chocholoque (the foolish, the flighty) -> 'the lost, the fleeing'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and accurate apart from one small nuance, while B misreads the 'ahuaque tepehuaque' idiom as rich people versus poor commoners, which adds content, and gets the greeting gift and several smaller points of sense wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the 'take example from' sense of maitechmixcuiti (rendered as 'be an example to us' instead of the sinner taking Semey as example)"], "added": ["your Redeemer"], "mistranslated": ["Absalom was about to depose David (quimotecuhtlaxilizquia in ipiltzin Absalon) -> 'David was about to take the lordship from his son Absalom'", "quimotetepachilhui, threw stones at him -> 'cursed him'", "omocuitihuetz, quickly confessed -> 'was struck with fear'", "oquimoteopohuili, offended God -> 'made a mockery of God'", "tiyollococolè, sick-hearted -> 'you of the stony heart'", "titetzauhtlahto, cenca tàyoni, titlatzacuiltiloni (speaker of ill omen, most wicked, deserving punishment) -> 'you who revile and so greatly seek vengeance and payment'", "quen timotlahpalohua, how will you greet him -> 'how you humble yourself'", "catlehuatl immotetlahpalohuaya, moteciauhquetzaya, motlayolcehuiaya (what greeting gift, what petition offering, what appeasement) -> 'what was your blame, what your weariness, what your comfort'", "tetlahpaloloni, something to offer as a greeting -> 'to offer you in exchange for blame'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["itzontlantzinco iquatlatzinco, at His head and brow -> 'behind His back and over His head' (slight)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Nahuatl closely and accurately, but A reverses the Absalom episode, misreads Semey's confession as fear, and garbles the greeting-gift passage and Semey's epithets."}
